fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers builds a reader-column expression for a property via ReaderSimpleValueExpressions whose resolved ordinal is present and, for a Nullable<T> or array property, the column is not DBNull
fields.response: read the value via DbDataReader.GetFieldValue<T>, made generic over the Nullable<T> property's underlying type or the array property's own array type, and assign it to the property directly; an ordinary non-nullable, non-array property is read and assigned the same way but without any DBNull guard
